title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（手代木純研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Teshirogi Jun)
educationalGoal: Students will learn about comfortable living with less environmental impact and urban development with natural environmental symbiosis. They will discover specific problems related to architectural environments and propose solutions. They will learn the design process of assigning settings, selecting methods, investigating/experimenting/ analyzing/verifying and proposing solutions. They will cultivate the ability to summarize results and make presentations.
advice:
[First term]
・Themes are decided through bibliographic surveys, field surveys, and preliminary experiments.
・Challenges are set and methods are selected.
・Students make interim presentations
 [Second term]
・Students pursue initiatives to resolve issues, analyze data, and propose solutions.
・Students create their reports.
・Students present their findings.
requiredKnowledge:
・Basic subjects of architecture.
・Broad interest in physics, biology, chemistry, materials, weather, history, the global environment, Plant science, Landscape engineering, etc.
・Awareness of environmental issues and actions.

activityGoals.body: Students can set specific project issues through bibliographic surveys, field surveys, and experiments.
Students can make plans for solving the problems.
Students can investigate, experiment, analyze, verify, and propose solutions
Students can summarize their results in a report and give a presentation.

achievementLevels.ideal:
・ Students actively and continuously work on project activities and create a report that fits the purpose.
・ Students’ performance is judged as excellent at the final presentation.
・ Student research results are in the form of content that can be submitted to peer-reviewed papers, such as those of the Architectural Institute of Japan, or, for socially-implemented results, can actually be implemented in the fields.
achievementLevels.standard:
・ Students work on project activities continuously and create a report that fits the purpose.
・ Students’ performance is judged as good at the final presentation.
・ Students’ project results have reached a level that can be presented to the Architectural Institute of Japan.

5.Utilization of open space

              Students will learn about comfortable living with less environmental impact and urban development with natural environmental symbiosis. They will discover specific problems related to architectural environments and propose solutions. They will learn the design process of assigning settings, selecting methods, investigating/experimenting/ analyzing/verifying and proposing solutions. They will cultivate the ability to summarize results and make presentations.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

・Themes are decided through bibliographic surveys, field surveys, and preliminary experiments.
・Challenges are set and methods are selected.
・Students make interim presentations
 [Second term]
・Students pursue initiatives to resolve issues, analyze data, and propose solutions.
・Students create their reports.
・Students present their findings.
